name: GolfNow US
description: GolfNow US public course discovery: location and course search, courses with tee times near a point, per-facility tee times with displayed rates, per-day availability summaries, course profiles and GolfNow reviews. Anonymous, read-only.

tools.name: Course detail
tools.description: Details for one `facility_id`. Two page fetches; no availability (use `facility_tee_times`).

options.name: facility_id
options.about: GolfNow facility id. Give exactly one of `facility_id`, `product_review_id`, `url`.

options.name: product_review_id
options.about: The course page key (`productReviewId` / `reviewId` from `search_courses`, `courses_near`, `course_reviews`); may be negative.

options.name: url
options.about: A golfnow.com course URL (`/courses/{productReviewId}-{slug}-details`) or facility URL (`/tee-times/facility/{id}-{slug}/search`).

response.about: Course profile from the facility and course pages: address, coordinates, contact, description, notices, par/yardage, tees, amenities, rating breakdown, AI review summary and any posted closure.

fields.name: country
fields.about: Storefront market: always `US` (www.golfnow.com).

fields.name: course_statistics
fields.about: Zero values from the site are reported as null (unknown).

fields.name: courses
fields.about: Playable courses at the facility from the GolfAdvisor feed; empty when the feed has none.

fields.name: detail_url
fields.about: Canonical course detail page.

fields.name: information
fields.about: Course notices as published (plain text with line breaks).

fields.name: observed_at_ms
fields.about: Observation time, milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

fields.name: review_count
fields.about: GolfPass/GolfAdvisor review count shown on the page.

fields.name: source
fields.about: Always `golfnow.com`.

fields.name: url
fields.about: Canonical facility tee-time page.

amenities.dress_code: Shirts must be worn at all times.

response.description_html:
Located just minutes from downtown Orlando, Dubsdread features the oldest public layout in the area, originally designed in 1923 and renovated in 2008. This classic course has plenty of history attached to it as the former site of the Orlando Open, when it hosted such golf legends as Sam Snead, Ben Hogan and Claude Harmon.

Today, golfers are treated to the same beautiful scenery and challenges of the original course, including narrow fairways and heavily bunkered, "postage stamp" style greens. A full restaurant and banquet facility complete the ultimate golfing experience.
response.information:
**ATTENTION GOLFERS**
The driving range is closed until further notice.

GREAT SPECIAL AVAILABLE TO NON-RESIDENTS AS WELL AS RESIDENTS OF FL!

Please bring a copy of your reservation to the golf course. We ask that our customers adhere to golf course dress code: No denim allowed, collared shirt is required, soft spikes only. Players & guests are required to follow all course policies and procedures as outlined by the staff.

review_summaries.summary: Dubsdread's greens consistently rank among Orlando's best, rolling quick and true even under heavy traffic and wet conditions. Exceptionally friendly staff and fair pricing make this uniquely-laid-out course a standout value in Central Florida.

tools.name: Course reviews
tools.description: Read what golfers wrote about a course. Only reviews left on GolfNow itself; the larger GolfPass review count on course records is a different corpus.

response.about: GolfNow-native reviews for a facility (author handle, rating, title, text, date of play), paginated.

fields.name: author
fields.about: Reviewer's public handle as displayed.

fields.name: reviewed_at
fields.about: Site-local timestamp `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS`.

reviews.author: Neil8140
reviews.text:
Course is just over 100 years old, you wouldn't think it.
Wonderful layout, with some very challenging holes. Loved it and will be playing again.
Greens had been dressed and sanded, but did not diminish enjoyment, full 5 stars from me
Plus get a warm up basket for the trackman range and GPS on the carts! What is not to like?
reviews.title: Hidden Gem

tools.name: Courses near
tools.description: Discover courses near a place (coordinates from `suggest_locations`); then call `facility_tee_times` with a `facility_id`.

options.name: date
options.about: Play date, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Defaults to tomorrow (UTC). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

options.name: hot_deals_only
options.about: Only tee times the site flags as Hot Deals (default false).

options.name: time_max
options.about: Latest tee time as a half-hour slot: 48 = midnight (default 48).

options.name: time_min
options.about: Earliest tee time as a half-hour slot: 0 = midnight, 14 = 7:00 AM (default 0).

response.about: Courses with tee times around a coordinate on one date: distance, rating, tee-time count, price range and first/last tee time per course, paginated.

fields.name: first_tee_time
fields.about: Course-local wall-clock time as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS` (no offset). GolfNow serialises these with a spurious `+00:00`; it is not UTC.

fields.name: last_tee_time
fields.about: Course-local wall-clock time as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS` (no offset). GolfNow serialises these with a spurious `+00:00`; it is not UTC.

fields.name: tee_time_count
fields.about: Tee times on the date matching the filters.

tools.name: Facility day summaries
tools.description: Pick a day before calling `facility_tee_times`; up to 31 days per call.

options.name: to
options.about: Last day, `YYYY-MM-DD` (default `from` + 6 days; at most 30 days after `from`). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

response.about: Per-day availability for one facility over a date range: tee-time count, min/max price and hot-deal flag per day.

tools.name: Facility tee times
tools.description: Availability and displayed prices for a known `facility_id` on one day. Discovery only: nothing is held or booked.

options.name: date
options.about: Play date, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Defaults to tomorrow (UTC). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

options.name: facility_id
options.about: GolfNow facility id, from `search_courses`, `courses_near` or a `/tee-times/facility/{id}-...` URL. Give this or `url`.

options.name: hot_deals_only
options.about: Only tee times the site flags as Hot Deals (default false).

options.name: limit
options.about: Return at most this many tee times (earliest first). `total` still counts the whole day; default all.

options.name: time_max
options.about: Latest tee time as a half-hour slot: 48 = midnight (default 48).

options.name: time_min
options.about: Earliest tee time as a half-hour slot: 0 = midnight, 14 = 7:00 AM (default 0).

options.name: url
options.about: A golfnow.com facility URL (`/tee-times/facility/{id}-{slug}/search` or `/tee-times/facility/{id}/tee-time/{teeTimeId}`) instead of `facility_id`.

response.about: Every tee time one facility sells on a date, with the displayed rate per tee time and its per-player price breakdown; optional player, hole and time filters.

fields.name: has_more_rates
fields.about: True when the site has further rate variants; see `tee_time_rates`.

fields.name: hole_options
fields.about: `18`, `9` or `18/9` as displayed.

fields.name: local_time
fields.about: Course-local wall-clock time as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS` (no offset). GolfNow serialises these with a spurious `+00:00`; it is not UTC.

fields.name: tee_time_id
fields.about: Default rate id of the slot (`defaultTeeTimeRateId`); feed to `tee_time_rates`.

tools.name: Search courses
tools.description: Find a `facility_id` from a course name; every id-keyed function needs one.

options.name: query
options.about: Course name or part of it, 1-100 characters.

response.about: Course directory search by name: facility ids, addresses, contact details, tax percentage, tee-time policy and the rate sets a course sells.

fields.name: detail_url
fields.about: Course detail page.

fields.name: facility_id
fields.about: GolfNow facility id (site `courseId`), key for tee-time functions.

fields.name: information
fields.about: Course notice text as published.

fields.name: product_review_id
fields.about: Key of the `/courses/{id}-...-details` page and reviews (site `reviewId`); may be negative.

fields.name: tax_percentage
fields.about: Course tax rate the site lists; null when not published.

fields.name: url
fields.about: Facility tee-time page.

courses.tee_time_policy:
All golfers must sign a Hold Harmless agreement during the check-in process in order to be permitted to play.
If you wish to cancel your reservation, Dubsdread requires that you do so at least 24 hours before the start of your round. Reservations canceled within this window are subject to being charged the full price for all rounds booked at the discretion of the course.  If you or a member of your party becomes unable to play, you will still be charged for each round of golf you purchased. Not showing for this tee time will result in a charge to your credit card for the entire amount due at the course.

tools.name: Suggest locations
tools.description: Turn a place name into latitude/longitude for `courses_near`.

response.about: Location type-ahead: cities and places with coordinates from GolfNow's geolookup, worldwide.

fields.name: facility_id
fields.about: Set when the suggestion is a course (site `contextInformation.courseId`); null for places.

fields.name: id
fields.about: GolfNow place id (hex string).

fields.name: type
fields.about: `city` or another site place type.

tools.name: Tee time rates
tools.description: Expand `has_more_rates` on a `facility_tee_times` row. Without `tee_time_id`, the first tee time of `date` for `players` is used.

options.name: date
options.about: Play date used when `tee_time_id` is omitted, `YYYY-MM-DD` (default tomorrow, UTC). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

options.name: tee_time_id
options.about: `tee_time_id` from `facility_tee_times` (may be negative). Omit to use the day's first tee time.

response.about: All rate variants the site offers for one tee time and player count (resident/non-resident, 9/18 holes, cart), with the per-player price breakdown. Read-only: nothing is held.

fields.name: due_online
fields.about: Amount the site would collect online per player; 0 when not computed for the anonymous view.

fields.name: greens_fee
fields.about: Per-player displayed price (site `greensFees`).

fields.name: name
fields.about: Rate name as displayed (e.g. Resident, Non Resident, Twilight).

fields.name: percent_discount
fields.about: Discount the site advertises against `regular_price`.

fields.name: player_rule
fields.about: Player counts the rate allows, in the site's vocabulary (`One`, `OneTwo`, `Any`, ...).

fields.name: rate_id
fields.about: `teeTimeRateId`; the key `tee_time_rates` and the detail URL use.

fields.name: regular_price
fields.about: Undiscounted per-player price the discount is computed from (site `ipo`).

fields.name: taxes_and_fees
fields.about: Site `taxesAndFees` per player; 0 when the site does not itemise them.

fields.name: transaction_fees
fields.about: Site `transactionFeesTotal` per player.
